reviews.finding: Clinic homepage offers a new-patient waiting list. This is a location-level pathway, not guaranteed immediate attachment or placement with a particular physician.
Clinic homepage names Dr. Hamza Aman and invites new patients to book a registration visit using its Ocean link. Appointment slots and enrolment were not confirmed.
Clinic homepage lists Dr. Rabiya Niaz among three doctors and invites new-patient forms by drop-off or mail. The invitation is clinic-wide, not guaranteed placement with Dr. Niaz.

Rendered family-practice page describes ongoing family care, links a first appointment and displays a new-patient invitation. Its booking page is an appointment-request form, not confirmed enrolment or a guaranteed slot. No form was submitted.
Published page invites people without a family doctor or NP to submit its New Client Intake Form. This new URL is readable manually; it has not yet been scanned by the scheduled monitor.
Homepage separately advertises family-doctor registration and walk-in appointments. Family-practice application invitation matches the existing listing; no enrolment guarantee.
Clinic page explicitly names Dr. Saadiyah Rao accepting patients for her family practice. Completed forms must be dropped off in person at 1345 Huron St; submission does not confirm registration.

Registration page offers a Family Doctor service and names Dr. Omowunmi Sonubi and Dr. Sunday Ocharifu. Published start date is February 23, 2026; this is a form review, not tested submission or guaranteed attachment.
About page describes family medicine and separately walk-in/same-day access. It does not settle whether advertised new visits constitute ongoing attachment; existing unknown status retained.
Kitchener family-practice page explicitly describes continuous healthcare, advertises accepting new patients and names Dr. Oladapo Oluseyi Ogunkoya. No registration was submitted.
About page is readable manually again. Its new-patient invitation is dental, not evidence that family-medicine rosters are open. Existing unconfirmed family-medicine status retained.
Official listing confirms the street address and phone number and explicitly says this is not a walk-in clinic. No current ongoing intake statement.
